newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia's olive oil exports surge in first qtr 97.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia's olive oil exports surge in first qtr 97.

text.p: Tunisia's olive oil exports amounted to 41.3 million dinars during the first quarter of 1997 against zero during the same period last year, official figures showed on Tuesday.

As of April 13, Tunisia, the world's largest exporter of olive oil, exported 22,471 tonnes of olive oil since the start of the season, including 18,398 tonnes by the country's 18 private exporters and 4,072 tonnes by the state-controlled Office National de l'Huile (ONH), agriculture ministry sources said.
Output for the current season which started last November and ended in March was put at 250,000 tonnes, thanks to important rainfall last year.
Drought in 1994-1995 reduced olive oil output to 60,000 tonnes last year and forced Tunisia to halt exports during the first half of 1996.
They said olive oil this year has average acidity of one percent.
Tunisia's record olive oil output was in the 1991/1992 season when it touched 280,000 tonnes. ($=1.09 dinar) --Tunis newsroom, 2161-787538
